import os
import random
import string
from typing import List

# Data type: arbitrary string (NUL-terminated C string when consumed by the stubs)
# Goal: produce an initial buffer that the harness will split into multiple FUZZ_PARAM_STR
# and FUZZ_PARAM_FILENAME consumptions. We include a variety of token-like strings, URIs,
# media names, IPP keywords, JWT/JWS snippets, HTTP headers, base64-ish chunks, and safe
# printable ASCII to maximize valid paths across the stubs. The buffer is a UTF-8 bytes
# sequence without embedded NUL so each extracted C-string is valid.

MAX_TOTAL = 4096

SCHEMES = [
    "http://example.com",
    "https://localhost",
    "ipp://printer.local/ipp/print",
    "ipps://127.0.0.1/ipp/print",
    "socket://192.168.1.50",
    "lpd://printer/queue",
    "usb://vendor/model",
]

MEDIA_PWG = [
    "iso_a4_210x297mm",
    "na_letter_8.5x11in",
    "iso_a5_148x210mm",
    "na_legal_8.5x14in",
    "jis_b5_182x257mm",
]

MEDIA_PPD = ["Letter", "A4", "Legal", "Executive", "A5", "B5"]
MEDIA_LEGACY = ["iso-a4", "na-letter", "jis-b5", "na-legal", "env-10", "monarch"]

IPP_NAMES = [
    "attributes-charset",
    "attributes-natural-language",
    "job-name",
    "copies",
    "printer-resolution",
    "sheet-collate",
    "document-octets",
]

JWT_HEADERS = [
    # base64url of {"alg":"HS256","typ":"JWT"}
    "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9",
    # base64url of {"alg":"none"}
    "eyJhbGciOiJub25lIn0",
]
JWT_PAYLOADS = [
    # base64url of {"sub":"1234567890","name":"John Doe","admin":true}
    "eyJzdWIiOiIxMjM0NTY3ODkwIiwibmFtZSI6IkpvaG4gRG9lIiwiYWRtaW4iOnRydWV9",
    # simple exp, iss
    "eyJpc3MiOiJleGFtcGxlIiwgImV4cCI6MTk5OTk5OTk5OX0",
]

HTTP_FIELDS = [
    "User-Agent: CUPS-Fuzz/1.0",
    "Accept: */*",
    "Content-Type: application/ipp",
    "Authorization: Bearer abc.def.ghi",
    "Cookie: a=b; c=d",
]

CONF_DIRECTIVES = [
    "ServerName example.local",
    "Browsing On",
    "WebInterface Yes",
    "Listen *:631",
]

PPD_TOKENS = [
    "*PPD-Adobe: \"4.3\"",
    "*FormatVersion: \"4.3\"",
    "*FileVersion: \"1.0\"",
    "*LanguageVersion: English",
    "*LanguageEncoding: ISOLatin1",
    "*PCFileName: \"TEST.PPD\"",
]

FORM_KEYS = ["user", "title", "copies", "media", "sides", "finishings"]

BASE64_CHARS = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + "+/="

SAFE_ASCII = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + "-_.:/?&=#%+,@\t "

FILES = [
    "alpha.txt",
    "doc.ppd",
    "image.pwg",
    "data.bin",
    "conf.conf",
]

URIS_EXTRA = [
    "/printers/queue",
    "/admin",
    "/jobs",
    "/api/print/1",
]

def rand_base64(rng: random.Random, n: int) -> str:
    n = max(8, min(128, n))
    s = ''.join(rng.choice(BASE64_CHARS) for _ in range(n))
    # ensure padding sometimes
    if rng.random() < 0.5:
        s = s.rstrip('=') + rng.choice(['', '=', '=='])
    return s

def rand_ascii(rng: random.Random, n: int) -> str:
    n = max(1, min(128, n))
    return ''.join(rng.choice(SAFE_ASCII) for _ in range(n)).strip()

def make_form(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    pairs = []
    count = rng.randint(1, 3)
    for _ in range(count):
        k = rng.choice(FORM_KEYS)
        v = rand_ascii(rng, rng.randint(1, 16))
        # restrict to unreserved
        v = ''.join(ch if (ch.isalnum() or ch in "-_.~") else '_' for ch in v)
        pairs.append(f"{k}={v}")
    return "&".join(pairs)

def make_query_uri(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    base = rng.choice(SCHEMES)
    res = rng.choice(URIS_EXTRA)
    q = make_form(rng)
    return f"{base}{res}?{q}"

def make_options_line(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    # cupsParseOptions expects space-separated name=value
    items = []
    for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 4)):
        name = rand_ascii(rng, rng.randint(3, 10)).replace(' ', '-')
        if not name:
            name = 'opt'
        val = rand_ascii(rng, rng.randint(1, 10)).replace(' ', '_')
        items.append(f"{name}={val}")
    return ' '.join(items)

def make_conf(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    lines = []
    lines.extend(CONF_DIRECTIVES)
    # a few sanitized random directives
    for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 3)):
        d = rand_ascii(rng, rng.randint(4, 12))
        d = ''.join(ch if (ch.isalnum() or ch in '-_') else '_' for ch in d)
        v = rand_ascii(rng, rng.randint(1, 12))
        lines.append(f"{d} {v}")
    return "\n".join(lines)

def make_ppd(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    lines = list(PPD_TOKENS)
    # Add a couple of options/choices
    lines.append("*OpenUI *PageSize/Media Size: PickOne")
    lines.append("*DefaultPageSize: Letter")
    for m in MEDIA_PPD[:3]:
        lines.append(f"*PageSize {m}/{m}: ")
    lines.append("*CloseUI: *PageSize")
    return "\n".join(lines)

def make_jwt_like(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    h = rng.choice(JWT_HEADERS)
    p = rng.choice(JWT_PAYLOADS)
    s = rand_base64(rng, 43).replace('+', '-').replace('/', '_').rstrip('=')
    return f"{h}.{p}.{s}"

def make_http_headers(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    lines = list(HTTP_FIELDS)
    # Vary user-agent a bit
    lines.append(f"User-Agent: fuzz/{rng.randint(1,5)}.{rng.randint(0,9)}")
    return "\n".join(lines)

def make_string_pool(rng: random.Random) -> List[str]:
    pool: List[str] = []
    # URIs and resources
    pool.extend(SCHEMES)
    pool.extend(URIS_EXTRA)
    pool.append(make_query_uri(rng))
    # Media names
    pool.extend(MEDIA_PWG)
    pool.extend(MEDIA_PPD)
    pool.extend(MEDIA_LEGACY)
    # IPP attribute names and common values
    pool.extend(IPP_NAMES)
    pool.extend(["utf-8", "en-us", "one-sided", "two-sided-long-edge", "draft", "high"])    
    # Filenames (FUZZ_PARAM_FILENAME expects path-like)
    pool.extend(FILES)
    # JWT/JWS examples
    pool.append(make_jwt_like(rng))
    # HTTP header lines block
    pool.append(make_http_headers(rng))
    # Config and options lines
    pool.append(make_conf(rng))
    pool.append(make_options_line(rng))
    # Form data
    pool.append(make_form(rng))
    # Base64 blob
    pool.append(rand_base64(rng, rng.randint(16, 72)))
    # PPD content snippet
    pool.append(make_ppd(rng))
    # Random ascii tokens
    for _ in range(8):
        pool.append(rand_ascii(rng, rng.randint(3, 24)))
    # Some known keywords used by various APIs
    pool.extend([
        "print-job",
        "operations-supported",
        "job-state",
        "printer-name",
        "credentials",
        "VAR",
        "FMT",
        "device",
        "Basic",
        "Bearer",
    ])
    # Ensure some delimiters for cupsArrayNewStrings, cupsArrayAddStrings
    pool.extend([
        ",alpha,beta,gamma",
        "one;two;three;four",
        "a|b|c|d",
    ])
    return pool


def assemble_buffer(parts: List[str], rng: random.Random, max_len: int) -> bytes:
    # Join using newlines and tabs as soft separators so consumers that read tokens or lines get variety.
    sep_choices = ["\n", "\t", "\n\n", " "]
    out = []
    total = 0
    for s in parts:
        sep = rng.choice(sep_choices)
        piece = s.strip("\0")  # ensure no NULs
        if not piece:
            continue
        # Bound growth
        add = piece + sep
        if total + len(add.encode('utf-8', 'ignore')) > max_len:
            break
        out.append(add)
        total += len(add.encode('utf-8', 'ignore'))
    data = ''.join(out).encode('utf-8', 'ignore')
    return data


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    # Build a pool and shuffle to vary order
    pool = make_string_pool(rng)
    rng.shuffle(pool)
    buf = assemble_buffer(pool, rng, MAX_TOTAL)
    # Ensure non-empty and <= 4096 bytes
    if not buf:
        buf = b"x\n"
    if len(buf) > MAX_TOTAL:
        buf = buf[:MAX_TOTAL]
    return buf

import random
import string
from typing import List

# This generator targets stubs that consume:
# - FUZZ_PARAM_STR(): arbitrary strings used as input to cupsArrayNewStrings and cupsArrayAddStrings
# - FUZZ_PARAM(unsigned char): single-byte delimiter
# The stubs expect valid C strings (NUL-terminated by C++ std::string c_str()) and arbitrary delimiters.
# Our goal is to provide interesting, yet valid inputs that exercise splitting behavior:
# - Empty strings
# - Strings without the delimiter
# - Strings with leading/trailing/adjacent delimiters (empty fields)
# - Strings with varied token sizes (very short/very long)
# - Strings containing embedded NULs are not applicable because std::string c_str() stops at first NUL; avoid NULs.
# - Include diverse character classes and multi-byte UTF-8 sequences (they are just bytes to split on a single-byte delimiter)
# The buffer will interleave multiple test cases so the fuzzer will draw from them for FUZZ_PARAM_STR and delimiter.

MAX_TOTAL = 4096

# Strategy: encode a small domain-specific corpus of (string, delimiter) pairs.
# The harness will read FUZZ_PARAM_STR and FUZZ_PARAM(unsigned char) independently, so we pack
# many candidates concatenated together separated by NULs. Typical fuzz harnesses consume bytes
# sequentially; providing a pool increases chance of good pairings.
# Layout:
#   [count (1 byte)] then for each entry:
#     [delim (1 byte)] [len (2 bytes little-endian)] [payload bytes (len)]
# The consumer doesn’t know this format, but FUZZ framework will take substrings/bytes in order.
# We merely need to ensure the raw buffer contains many plausible strings and many delimiter bytes.


def _rand_utf8_chars(r: random.Random, n: int) -> str:
    # Mix ASCII, punctuation, whitespace, and some multi-byte UTF-8
    ascii_pool = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + " _-:.@/\\|()[]{}"
    parts: List[str] = []
    while len("".join(parts)) < n:
        choice = r.random()
        if choice < 0.75:
            parts.append(r.choice(ascii_pool))
        else:
            # pick a code point from some ranges
            cp_ranges = [
                (0x00A1, 0x00FF),  # Latin-1 supplement (avoid NUL; NUL not in this range)
                (0x0100, 0x017F),  # Latin Extended-A
                (0x0400, 0x04FF),  # Cyrillic
                (0x0370, 0x03FF),  # Greek
                (0x4E00, 0x4E5F),  # small slice of CJK
            ]
            lo, hi = r.choice(cp_ranges)
            cp = r.randint(lo, hi)
            parts.append(chr(cp))
    s = "".join(parts)
    return s[:n]


def _make_tokens(r: random.Random, delim: str, count: int) -> str:
    # Build a string with varied token sizes and empty fields
    tokens: List[str] = []
    for i in range(count):
        t_choice = r.random()
        if t_choice < 0.2:
            tok = ""  # empty token
        elif t_choice < 0.5:
            tok = _rand_utf8_chars(r, r.randint(1, 6))
        elif t_choice < 0.85:
            tok = _rand_utf8_chars(r, r.randint(7, 24))
        else:
            tok = _rand_utf8_chars(r, r.randint(25, 120))
        tokens.append(tok)
    # Randomly add leading/trailing delimiter and runs of delimiters
    s = delim.join(tokens)
    if r.random() < 0.5:
        s = delim + s
    if r.random() < 0.5:
        s = s + delim
    if r.random() < 0.4:
        # insert a run of delimiters somewhere
        run_len = r.randint(2, 6)
        pos = r.randint(0, len(s))
        s = s[:pos] + (delim * run_len) + s[pos:]
    return s


def _pick_delim(r: random.Random) -> int:
    # Prefer common delimiters but include full 0x01..0xFF except 0x00
    common = [ord(c) for c in [",", "|", ":", ";", " ", "\t", "\n", "\r", "/", "\\", "-", "."]]
    if r.random() < 0.7:
        return r.choice(common)
    else:
        # choose non-NUL arbitrary byte
        return r.randint(1, 255)


def _sanitize_for_delim(delim_byte: int) -> str:
    # Return the actual character for the delimiter byte
    if delim_byte == 0:
        # we avoid NUL, but guard anyway
        delim_byte = 1
    return bytes([delim_byte]).decode('latin1')


def _encode_entry(delim_byte: int, payload: bytes) -> bytes:
    # entry encoding: delim(1) + len(2 little) + payload
    ln = len(payload)
    return bytes([delim_byte, ln & 0xFF, (ln >> 8) & 0xFF]) + payload


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    r = random.Random(seed)

    entries: List[bytes] = []

    # 1) Edge cases with empty and single-token strings
    for _ in range(3):
        d = _pick_delim(r)
        delim = _sanitize_for_delim(d)
        s = ""
        entries.append(_encode_entry(d, s.encode('utf-8')))
        s = _rand_utf8_chars(r, r.randint(1, 16))  # no delimiter present
        if delim in s:
            s = s.replace(delim, "")
        entries.append(_encode_entry(d, s.encode('utf-8')))

    # 2) Typical CSV-like content
    for _ in range(5):
        d = ord(',')
        s = _make_tokens(r, ",", r.randint(3, 20))
        entries.append(_encode_entry(d, s.encode('utf-8')))

    # 3) Pipe/semicolon/space/tab separated variants
    for ch in ['|', ';', ' ', '\t', ':']:
        d = ord(ch)
        s = _make_tokens(r, ch, r.randint(2, 18))
        entries.append(_encode_entry(d, s.encode('utf-8')))

    # 4) Newline/CR separated lines to test multi-line splitting
    for ch in ['\n', '\r']:
        d = ord(ch)
        s = _make_tokens(r, ch, r.randint(2, 25))
        entries.append(_encode_entry(d, s.encode('utf-8')))

    # 5) Random delimiters with long and short records
    for _ in range(10):
        d = _pick_delim(r)
        delim = _sanitize_for_delim(d)
        s = _make_tokens(r, delim, r.randint(1, 30))
        # trim to keep total size under limit later; entries are length-prefixed
        payload = s.encode('utf-8')[:512]
        entries.append(_encode_entry(d, payload))

    # 6) Delimiter absent large token
    for _ in range(3):
        d = _pick_delim(r)
        delim = _sanitize_for_delim(d)
        token = _rand_utf8_chars(r, r.randint(64, 256))
        token = token.replace(delim, "")
        entries.append(_encode_entry(d, token.encode('utf-8')))

    # Assemble with header count and possibly truncate to MAX_TOTAL
    # Header: count (1 byte, modulo 255)
    count = min(len(entries), 255)
    buf = bytes([count]) + b"".join(entries[:count])

    if len(buf) > MAX_TOTAL:
        buf = buf[:MAX_TOTAL]
        # ensure we don't cut in the middle of UTF-8 for the fuzzer, but std::string treats bytes; safe.

    return buf

import os
import random
import string
from typing import List

# Data type: filesystem path
# Goal: Produce bytes containing one or more interesting, valid paths for FUZZ_PARAM_FILENAME() and FUZZ_PARAM_STR()
# Strategy:
# - Create a self-contained text buffer that the harness will write to a temp file and then pass the filename to stubs.
# - The buffer content is arbitrary; many stubs only require the file to exist. We'll include varied textual content to
#   exercise read/parse paths (IPP text reader, JSON export target, etc.).
# - For FUZZ_PARAM_STR uses that expect resource names, printer names, common names, tokens, etc., the harness generates
#   them independently; our buffer just needs to be valid file data and reasonably sized.
# - Ensure length <= 4096 bytes.
# - Vary content with seed to cover: ASCII text, lines, comments (#), IPP-like tokens, JSON-ish snippet, and random bytes.

SAFE_ASCII = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + "-_./@:,+()[]{} "+"\t"


def _rand_ascii(rng: random.Random, n: int) -> str:
    return ''.join(rng.choice(SAFE_ASCII) for _ in range(n))


def _make_ipp_text(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    # Produce a minimal IPP text file style content with comments and simple attributes
    lines: List[str] = []
    lines.append("# IPP text sample")
    lines.append("attributes-charset\tcharset\tutf-8")
    lines.append("attributes-natural-language\tlanguage\ten-us")
    # Add some operation/job/printer groups with random integers/strings
    for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 3)):
        lines.append("operation-attributes-tag")
        lines.append(f"requesting-user-name\tnameWithoutLanguage\t{_rand_ascii(rng, rng.randint(3,10))}")
        lines.append(f"job-id\tinteger\t{rng.randint(1, 100000)}")
    # A token-like section to exercise token readers
    for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 3)):
        tok = _rand_ascii(rng, rng.randint(4, 16)).replace('\n', ' ')
        lines.append(f"# token {tok}")
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"


def _make_json_snippet(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    # Small valid JSON object to support JSON export/read scenarios
    keys = ["name", "title", "value", "array", "flag", "nested"]
    obj = {
        "name": _rand_ascii(rng, rng.randint(3, 12)).strip(),
        "title": _rand_ascii(rng, rng.randint(3, 18)).strip(),
        "value": rng.randint(0, 1000000),
        "array": [rng.randint(0, 9) for _ in range(rng.randint(2, 6))],
        "flag": bool(rng.getrandbits(1)),
        "nested": {"k": _rand_ascii(rng, rng.randint(2, 8)).strip()}
    }
    # Manual compact JSON assembly to avoid imports
    def esc(s: str) -> str:
        return s.replace('\\', '\\\\').replace('"', '\\"')
    arr = ",".join(str(x) for x in obj["array"])
    json_str = (
        '{' \
        f'"name":"{esc(obj["name"])}",' \
        f'"title":"{esc(obj["title"])}",' \
        f'"value":{obj["value"]},' \
        f'"array":[{arr}],' \
        f'"flag":{str(obj["flag"]).lower()},' \
        f'"nested":{{"k":"{esc(obj["nested"]["k"]) }"}}' \
        '}'
    )
    return json_str + "\n"


def _make_text_blob(rng: random.Random, target_len: int) -> bytes:
    # Compose sections: header, IPP-like, JSON, random ASCII lines, and a small binary trailer
    parts: List[bytes] = []

    # Header comment block
    header = [
        "# CUPS fuzz seed block",
        f"# seed={rng.randrange(1<<32)}",
        "# This file contains mixed content for exercising readers.",
        "",
    ]
    parts.append(("\n".join(header) + "\n").encode("utf-8"))

    # IPP-style text
    if rng.random() < 0.9:
        parts.append(_make_ipp_text(rng).encode("utf-8"))

    # JSON snippet
    if rng.random() < 0.9:
        parts.append(_make_json_snippet(rng).encode("utf-8"))

    # Additional random ASCII lines to reach target length
    while sum(len(p) for p in parts) < target_len - 64:
        line_len = rng.randint(20, 120)
        line = _rand_ascii(rng, line_len).rstrip()
        parts.append((line + "\n").encode("utf-8", errors="ignore"))
        if rng.random() < 0.15:
            # add a comment line
            parts.append(("# " + _rand_ascii(rng, rng.randint(5, 40)) + "\n").encode("utf-8"))

    # Small binary-ish trailer to ensure non-text bytes don't break consumers that ignore content
    trailer_len = rng.randint(8, 32)
    trailer = bytearray(trailer_len)
    for i in range(trailer_len):
        trailer[i] = rng.randint(0, 255)
    parts.append(bytes(trailer))

    blob = b"".join(parts)
    # Trim to requested target length
    if len(blob) > target_len:
        blob = blob[:target_len]
    return blob


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    # Choose a target size in a reasonable range (many APIs read small chunks, but allow up to 4KiB)
    size = rng.randint(256, 2048)
    return _make_text_blob(rng, size)

import random
import string
from typing import List

# This generator targets multiple fuzz stubs that consume string tokens and structured names.
# We will produce a bytes buffer that contains several newline-separated strings likely to be
# consumed by FUZZ_PARAM_STR and filename providers. The content focuses on:
# - token-like identifiers (alnum, '-', '_') for directives, HTTP header names, PWG parts
# - DNS-SD service instance names, types, and domains
# - PWG media size name components and units
# - Key/value-like lines to help cupsFilePutConf succeed when used as a file content source
# - Common HTTP header names to map to http_field_t
# The buffer remains under 4096 bytes.

TOK_CHARS = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + "-_"

HTTP_HEADERS = [
    "Accept", "Accept-Encoding", "Accept-Language", "Authorization",
    "Cache-Control", "Connection", "Content-Encoding", "Content-Language",
    "Content-Length", "Content-Location", "Content-MD5", "Content-Range",
    "Content-Type", "Date", "ETag", "Expect", "Host", "If-Modified-Since",
    "If-Unmodified-Since", "Keep-Alive", "Last-Modified", "Link", "Location",
    "Range", "Referer", "Retry-After", "Transfer-Encoding", "Upgrade",
    "User-Agent", "WWW-Authenticate", "Allow", "Server", "Authentication-Info",
    "Origin", "Strict-Transport-Security"
]

PWG_PREFIXES = [
    "iso", "na", "jis", "om", "roc", "custom", "pwg"
]

PWG_NAMES = [
    "letter", "legal", "a4", "a3", "tabloid", "executive", "env10",
    "envDL", "photo_4x6", "photo_5x7", "square_89x89", "indexcard"
]

DNS_TYPES = ["_ipp._tcp", "_ipps._tcp", "_printer._tcp", "_http._tcp"]
DOMAINS = ["local.", "home.", "lan."]
UNITS = ["mm", "in"]

CONF_DIRECTIVES = [
    "ServerName", "Listen", "MaxClients", "LogLevel", "ErrorLog",
    "Port", "DefaultLanguage", "DefaultCharset", "Browsing", "BrowseLocalProtocols",
    "WebInterface"
]

CONF_VALUES = [
    "On", "Off", "info", "warn", "debug", "_var_log_cups_error_log",
    "_var_run_cupsd_pid", "en_US", "de_DE", "fr_FR", "utf-8", "us-english",
]

HTTP_SAFE_TOKENS = [h.replace("-", "-") for h in HTTP_HEADERS]


def _rand_token(rng: random.Random, min_len=1, max_len=32) -> str:
    n = rng.randint(min_len, max_len)
    return ''.join(rng.choice(TOK_CHARS) for _ in range(n))


def _rand_pwg_keyword(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    prefix = rng.choice(PWG_PREFIXES)
    name = rng.choice(PWG_NAMES)
    # PWG formatted: prefix.name-widthxlengthunits
    width = rng.randint(1000, 40000)   # 10mm to 400mm in 0.01mm
    length = rng.randint(1000, 60000)  # 10mm to 600mm in 0.01mm
    units = rng.choice(UNITS)
    return f"{prefix}.{name}-{width}x{length}{units}"


def _rand_dnssd_fullname(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    # Instance name limited and token-like per fuzz stub sanitization
    inst = _rand_token(rng, 3, 16)
    rtype = rng.choice(DNS_TYPES)
    domain = rng.choice(DOMAINS)
    return f"{inst}.{rtype}.{domain}"


def _conf_line(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    dir_name = rng.choice(CONF_DIRECTIVES) if rng.random() < 0.7 else _rand_token(rng, 2, 16)
    # Occasionally emit directive without value to exercise NULL value paths
    if rng.random() < 0.2:
        return dir_name
    # token-like value or quoted multi token
    if rng.random() < 0.6:
        val = rng.choice(CONF_VALUES) if rng.random() < 0.7 else _rand_token(rng, 1, 24)
        return f"{dir_name} {val}"
    else:
        # produce something that becomes token-like when sanitized by stub
        words = [rng.choice([_rand_token(rng,1,8), "value", "path", "cups"]) for _ in range(rng.randint(2,4))]
        return f"{dir_name} {' '.join(words)}"


def _http_header_line(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    h = rng.choice(HTTP_SAFE_TOKENS)
    # simple values
    vals = [
        "text/plain", "application/json", "chunked", "gzip", "en-US,en;q=0.9",
        "keep-alive", "bytes=0-1023", "Mozilla/5.0"
    ]
    if rng.random() < 0.5:
        return h
    return f"{h}: {rng.choice(vals)}"


def _pwg_parts(rng: random.Random) -> List[str]:
    # Provide parts that pwgFormatSizeName consumes: prefix, name, width, length, units
    prefix = rng.choice(PWG_PREFIXES)
    name = rng.choice(PWG_NAMES)
    width = str(rng.randint(100, 200000))
    length = str(rng.randint(100, 300000))
    units = rng.choice(UNITS)
    return [prefix, name, width, length, units]


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)

    lines: List[str] = []

    # 1) Config-like lines for cupsFilePutConf
    for _ in range(rng.randint(5, 12)):
        lines.append(_conf_line(rng))

    # 2) HTTP header names for httpFieldValue mapping
    for _ in range(rng.randint(5, 15)):
        lines.append(_http_header_line(rng))

    # 3) PWG media keyword samples and decomposed parts
    for _ in range(rng.randint(3, 8)):
        lines.append(_rand_pwg_keyword(rng))
        parts = _pwg_parts(rng)
        lines.extend(parts)  # prefix, name, width, length, units

    # 4) DNS-SD full names and components to exercise assemble/separate
    for _ in range(rng.randint(3, 8)):
        lines.append(_rand_dnssd_fullname(rng))
        # Also provide components
        lines.append(_rand_token(rng, 3, 16))  # instance name
        lines.append(rng.choice(DNS_TYPES))
        lines.append(rng.choice(DOMAINS))

    # 5) Generic token-like identifiers for miscellaneous FUZZ_PARAM_STR uses
    for _ in range(rng.randint(10, 30)):
        lines.append(_rand_token(rng, 1, 32))

    # Ensure size limit
    blob = ("\n".join(lines)).encode("utf-8")
    if len(blob) > 4096:
        blob = blob[:4096]
        # ensure not cutting a multibyte sequence (but ASCII only here)
    return blob
